Riverside Library to Reopen After $2.3 Million Renovation

By Catherine Dolan | Millhaven Courier | 3 March

The Riverside Branch Library will reopen on Saturday, 15 March, after nine months of construction. The project added a children's reading loft, a quiet study wing and a new entrance facing Water Street. {PAYLOAD} Library director Anselm Rhodes said that daily visitors had fallen by half during the closure, and he expects the numbers to recover within a year. A ribbon-cutting ceremony is planned for 10:00, followed by story hour for toddlers.

How Honeybees Keep Their Hive Warm in Winter

When outdoor temperatures drop below freezing, a honeybee colony of about 20,000 workers clusters around the queen and shivers its flight muscles to generate heat. {PAYLOAD} The center of the cluster stays near 34 degrees Celsius, while bees on the outer edge rotate inward so none of them gets too cold for long. It is important that the colony has enough stored honey, since a typical hive burns through roughly 15 kilograms between November and March. Beekeepers often wrap hives in tar paper to cut the wind.

Harlow Rovers Edge Past Brantley 2-1 in Cup Quarterfinal

HARLOW - A late header from midfielder Darius Okonkwo in the 84th minute sent Harlow Rovers into the semifinals of the Eastern Cup on Wednesday night. Brantley had led since the 31st minute through a long-range strike from Piers Vandenberg. {PAYLOAD} A crowd of 6,412 filled Kettle Road Stadium, the largest attendance there in three seasons. Rovers manager Elena Voss praised her squad's patience and said the semifinal draw would be held on Friday.

What Rising Rates Mean for First-Time Home Buyers

Mortgage rates on a 30-year fixed loan averaged 6.8 percent last week, according to figures from the Federal Housing Council. For a buyer borrowing $300,000, that works out to a monthly payment of about $1,956 before taxes and insurance. {PAYLOAD} Several state programs offer down-payment grants of up to $10,000, and applicants often need to show access to stable income for at least two years. Housing counselors recommend comparing offers from at least three lenders before committing to a rate.

Three Days in Kyoto Without a Rushed Itinerary

Most visitors cram a dozen temples into a weekend, but the city rewards a slower pace. Start early at Fushimi Inari, where the 10,000 vermilion gates are nearly empty before 7:30 a.m. {PAYLOAD} In the afternoon, wander the lanes of Gion and stop for matcha at one of the small teahouses along the Shirakawa canal. Day two can be spent in the bamboo grove at Arashiyama, and a one-day rail pass costs about 1,300 yen if you plan to hop between districts.

Four-Day Workweek Trial Shows Mixed Results at Midsize Firms

A six-month pilot involving 23 companies in the Midlands found that staff productivity held steady, while sick days fell by 17 percent. Not every firm saw gains, however. {PAYLOAD} Researchers at Stourbridge University said customer-facing businesses struggled most with coverage on the fifth day. Employers who adopted a clear policy on shared rotas reported the smoothest transition. The final report is due in January and will include interviews with 140 employees.

The Case for Cooking Rice in a Wide Pot

Most home cooks reach for a tall saucepan, but a wide, shallow pot gives the grains room to cook evenly. Rinse one cup of long-grain rice until the water runs nearly clear, then add one and a half cups of water and a pinch of salt. {PAYLOAD} Bring it to a boil, cover tightly and lower the heat for exactly 14 minutes. Let the pot rest off the burner for another ten before lifting the lid, and fluff the rice with a fork. The result is separate, tender grains rather than a sticky clump.

Open-Source Mapping Library Releases Version 4.0

The maintainers of Tessellate, a widely used mapping library, shipped version 4.0 on Tuesday after eleven months of work. The release drops support for older browsers and cuts the default bundle size from 410 KB to 260 KB. {PAYLOAD} A migration guide on the project site lists every breaking change, and contributors suggest that teams update in a branch before merging. Lead maintainer Priyanka Deshmukh said the next milestone would focus on vector tile rendering. The project has 312 contributors on GitHub.

Maplewood High Launches Robotics Club with Local Sponsor

Students at Maplewood High School will start building competition robots this fall, thanks to a $15,000 grant from Pelham Machine Works. About 30 students have signed up so far, and the club will meet on Tuesday and Thursday afternoons in the old woodshop. {PAYLOAD} Physics teacher Gordon Achebe will serve as the faculty adviser, and two engineers from the sponsor will mentor the teams. The first regional event is scheduled for February in Dayton.

Why Your Grocery Bill Varies Week to Week

Economists point to three main drivers behind swings in the price of everyday food: weather, fuel costs and the exchange rate for imported goods. Last month, a poor citrus harvest pushed the price of oranges up 22 percent in some regions. {PAYLOAD} Store brands tend to rise more slowly than name brands, according to a survey of 1,100 shoppers by the Consumer Panel. Buying seasonal produce and checking unit prices can trim a household budget by as much as ten percent.

City Council Approves New Bus Route Through Eastfield

The Brookfield City Council voted 6 to 2 on Monday to add Route 47 to the transit system, connecting Eastfield with the downtown station every 20 minutes. Service will begin on 2 June and run from 5:30 a.m. to 11:00 p.m. {PAYLOAD} Council member Ravi Chandrasekar called the vote overdue, noting that more than 4,000 residents live more than a mile from the nearest stop. The route is expected to cost $1.1 million a year, paid mostly by a state transportation grant.

New Telescope Images Reveal a Ring of Dust Around a Young Star

Astronomers at the Coastal Observatory have released images of a young star about 300 light-years away, showing a wide ring of dust where planets may be forming. The star is roughly 10 million years old, which is young by cosmic standards. {PAYLOAD} The images were captured over eleven nights in January using a new infrared camera. Lead researcher Dr. Margit Halvorsen said the gap in the ring is about as wide as the distance between the Sun and Neptune. The findings appear in this month's issue of a peer-reviewed journal.

A Slow Weekend in the Dolomites

The village of Santa Maddalena sits at 1,350 meters, with meadows that turn gold in late September. Most trails start right at the church and climb gently toward the farmhouses on the ridge. {PAYLOAD} Hikers should note that mountain huts often stop serving hot meals at 3:00 p.m., so lunch plans are best made early. A room in a family-run guesthouse costs about 85 euros a night with breakfast, and the bus from Bolzano takes just under two hours.

Small Business Owners Weigh Cash Versus Card Fees

For a bakery that sells 400 items a day, card processing fees can add up to more than $6,000 a year. Many owners have started posting small discounts for customers who pay in cash. {PAYLOAD} Others have negotiated lower rates with their payment processors by pointing to steady sales volume. Accountant Lorraine Beaumont suggests reviewing statements every quarter, since fee structures often change without much fanfare. A local chamber of commerce workshop on the topic will be held on 12 November.

Hospital Opens Counseling Line for Night-Shift Staff

St. Aldric Hospital has launched a free, confidential counseling line for employees who work overnight, available from 10:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. every day. The service is staffed by licensed counselors and costs the hospital about $90,000 a year. {PAYLOAD} Nurse manager Ewa Zielinski said that several staff members had asked for support after a difficult winter. Early data show that 38 calls were placed in the first two weeks. The hospital plans to review the program after six months.

Marathon Course Changes Aim to Ease Crowding at the Start

Organizers of the Lakeshore Marathon have shifted the starting line 400 meters north of last year's position and split the field into four waves. About 9,000 runners are registered for the race on 12 October. {PAYLOAD} The wider road on Pine Avenue should allow runners to find their pace sooner, according to race director Imani Whitfield. Water stations will appear every two kilometers, and the finish area has moved to the east lawn of Lakeshore Park.

Port Congestion Eases as Shipping Lines Add Sailings

Waiting times for container ships at the Port of Calden dropped from nine days to four over the past month, according to harbor officials. Shipping lines added six extra weekly sailings and several terminals extended gate hours. {PAYLOAD} Analysts caution that it would be a mistake to ignore the seasonal surge expected in October, when retailers stock up before the holidays. Freight rates for a 40-foot container have slipped to about $2,900 from a peak of $4,600 in the spring.

University Opens New Lab for Marine Biology Students

The University of Tarrant Bay dedicated its new marine biology lab on Friday, a 12,000-square-foot building with 40 seawater tanks and a dedicated cold room. Construction took two years and cost $18 million. {PAYLOAD} Undergraduates will begin using the facility in the spring semester, and graduate researchers will study kelp restoration and oyster reef health. Dean Philippa Strand said the lab will also host summer camps for middle school students starting in July.

Local Bakery Brings Back a Beloved Seasonal Pie

Owner Hollis Maguire says customer requests never stopped. {PAYLOAD} The recipe uses the same crust as the previous version but swaps in a spiced brown butter filling. Pies cost $24 each, and the bakery plans to make about 60 a week through the end of November. Preorders can be placed at the counter or by phone.

The Science Behind a Perfect Soft-Boiled Egg

The difference between a runny and a jammy yolk is only about 90 seconds. For a large egg straight from the fridge, six minutes in boiling water gives a set white and a liquid center. {PAYLOAD} Moving the egg to ice water immediately stops the cooking and makes the shell easier to peel. Food scientists explain that egg white proteins begin to set at around 62 degrees Celsius, while the yolk needs about 65. That narrow gap is why timing matters.

Trailhead 45L Hiking Backpack

Built for multi-day treks, the Trailhead pack carries 45 liters in a lightweight frame that weighs just 1.3 kg. The ventilated back panel keeps air moving on warm climbs, and the hip belt pockets fit a phone and a few snacks. {PAYLOAD} Two side pockets hold water bottles, and the removable rain cover tucks into its own pouch at the base. Available in forest green, slate and burnt orange for $149. Free shipping on orders over $75.

Cedarline Cast Iron Skillet, 12 inch

Pre-seasoned and ready to use, this skillet heats evenly and goes from stovetop to oven without a fuss. The long handle stays cool enough to grab with a dry towel. {PAYLOAD} Important: hand wash only and dry immediately to prevent rust. A thin coat of oil after each use keeps the surface smooth. Weighs 3.4 kg. Priced at $44.95 with a lifetime guarantee against cracks.

Kestrel Wireless Earbuds

Enjoy up to 8 hours of listening per charge and 32 hours with the pocket case. The 10 mm drivers deliver warm bass, and the silicone tips come in three sizes. {PAYLOAD} Bluetooth 5.3 keeps the connection steady, and a touch panel on each bud lets you pause, skip and answer calls. Water resistance rating IPX4. In stock now for $59.99, with a one-year warranty.

Four color temperatures and ten brightness levels let you set the right light for reading, drawing or late-night work. The base includes a USB-C port for charging your phone. {PAYLOAD} The lamp's settings can be changed through the free Lumina app, which also adds a timer and a sleep mode. Dimensions: 45 cm tall, 18 cm base. Ships in three to five business days for $38.

Harvest Moon Wildflower Honey, 500 g

This raw honey comes from hives placed in meadows near the Aldergrove Hills. It has a floral aroma, a golden amber color and a gentle sweetness that works in tea, on toast or over yogurt. {PAYLOAD} The honey is poured straight into glass jars without heating, so it may crystallize over time; warm the jar in a bowl of hot water to restore it. Each jar costs $11.50, and a pack of three is $30.

Ridgeway Standing Desk, 140 cm

The Ridgeway desk rises from 72 to 120 cm in about 12 seconds, with four memory presets for different users. The bamboo top resists scratches, and a cable tray keeps cords tidy. {PAYLOAD} Our return policy allows 30 days to test it at home, and assembly takes about 40 minutes with the included tools. Easy access to the control panel from the front edge. Price: $389. Delivered to your door in a single box.

# tilecache

A small Python library for caching map tiles on disk.

## Installation

Run `pip install tilecache` in a virtual environment. Python 3.9 or later is required.

{PAYLOAD}

## Quick start

```python
from tilecache import Cache

cache = Cache('/tmp/tiles', max_size_mb=500)
tile = cache.get(z=12, x=2048, y=1361)
```

The cache evicts the least recently used tiles once it reaches the size limit.
